itineraries.title: Albania in 3 days
itineraries.tagline: Tirana and Berat: a capital and a UNESCO old town
itineraries.summary: A short first taste that works with a long weekend and Tirana flights. You'll see the country's busy modern face, then slow down in one of its most beautiful old towns. No car needed.
itineraries.bestFor: Long weekends, city breaks, first taste
itineraries.transport: Bus or taxi; no car needed

days.title: Arrive in Tirana
days.morning: Land at Tirana International Airport and take the airport bus or an official taxi into the centre. Drop your bags and get your bearings on Skanderbeg Square.
days.afternoon: Spend a couple of hours at Bunk'Art 2, a Cold War bunker turned museum a short walk from the square. Then wander past the colourful buildings and the renovated Pyramid.
days.evening: Dinner and drinks in Blloku, the former communist leaders' quarter, now the city's liveliest neighbourhood.
days.tip: Get some lek from an ATM at the airport or in town; small cafés and taxis prefer cash.

days.title: Tirana to Berat
days.morning: Ride the Dajti Ekspres cable car for a view over the city, or browse the New Bazaar for breakfast and coffee. Head to the bus terminal late morning.
days.afternoon: Arrive in Berat and check into a guesthouse in the old Mangalem or Gorica quarter. Cross the Gorica footbridge and walk along the river.
days.evening: Watch the evening light on the 'thousand windows' from the Gorica side, then have dinner with local wine.
days.tip: Ask your Tirana accommodation which terminal Berat buses leave from that day.

days.title: Berat's castle, then back
days.travel: Bus back to Tirana: about 2–2.5 hours
days.morning: Climb to Berat Castle early, before the heat. People still live inside its walls, among Byzantine churches and the Onufri Museum of icons.
days.afternoon: Lunch in the old town, then take an afternoon bus back to Tirana. If you have a flight, allow a good margin for traffic to the airport.
days.evening: A last stroll along Tirana's Lana river and a final byrek or tavë kosi.
days.tip: With an extra half day, a guided trip to the Osum Canyon or a family winery near Berat is well worth it.

itineraries.title: Albania in 7 days
itineraries.tagline: From Tirana to the Riviera through two stone cities
itineraries.summary: The classic first trip: the capital, the UNESCO towns of Berat and Gjirokastër, the Blue Eye spring and the best of the Ionian coast. It works by bus, but a rental car gives you more freedom on the coast.
itineraries.bestFor: First-time visitors, mix of culture and beaches
itineraries.transport: Buses work; a rental car is easier on the coast

days.title: Arrive in Tirana
days.morning: Arrive at Tirana International Airport and head into the centre by airport bus or official taxi.
days.afternoon: Skanderbeg Square, the National History Museum and Bunk'Art 2 give you the story of the country in an afternoon.
days.tip: If you're renting a car, pick it up on day 2 rather than driving in Tirana traffic straight off the plane.

days.title: Tirana to Berat
days.travel: About 2–2.5 hours by bus or car
days.afternoon: Settle into the old town, cross the Gorica bridge and walk the riverside.
days.evening: Sunset over the Mangalem windows, then dinner with local wine.
days.tip: Driving? Stop at a winery on the way in; the Berat area is Albania's best-known wine region.

days.title: Berat to Gjirokastër
days.travel: About 3–3.5 hours by car; longer by bus with a change
days.morning: Berat Castle and the Onufri Museum before the day warms up.
days.afternoon: Travel south to Gjirokastër through the Drino valley.
days.evening: Wander the stone lanes of the old bazaar and eat in a traditional restaurant.
days.tip: Buses stop in the new town. Take a short taxi up the hill to the old town with your bags.

days.title: Gjirokastër to the coast via the Blue Eye
days.morning: Gjirokastër Castle, then a restored tower house such as Skenduli or Zekate.
days.afternoon: Stop at the Blue Eye spring on the road to Sarandë, then continue to Ksamil.
days.evening: First swim and a seafood dinner by the water.
days.tip: By bus, take a Sarandë-bound service, get off at the Blue Eye turn-off and walk about 2 km in; then flag a later bus or taxi.

days.title: Ksamil and Butrint
days.travel: Butrint is about 10 minutes from Ksamil
days.morning: Visit Butrint early, while it's cool and quiet: the Greek theatre, the baptistery and the Venetian tower.
days.afternoon: Beach time, and swim or kayak out to the Ksamil islets.
days.evening: Sunset drinks on Sarandë's promenade, looking across to Corfu.
days.tip: In July and August, book your sunbeds and dinner tables early.

days.title: Up the Riviera to Himarë
days.travel: About 1.5 hours by car or bus
days.morning: Drive north along the coast, stopping at Porto Palermo's little fortress.
days.afternoon: Beach time at Livadhi or Potami, or hike down to Gjipe beach and its canyon.
days.evening: Climb to Himarë's old village for sunset, then fish by the harbour.
days.tip: Coastal buses are frequent in summer but sparse from October to May. Check times locally.

days.title: Over the Llogara Pass to Tirana
days.travel: About 4–5 hours by car or bus
days.morning: A last swim, then up the Llogara Pass for the big view over the Riviera.
days.afternoon: Continue via Vlorë back to Tirana, or straight to the airport.
days.tip: The Llogara road is steep with hairpins. Take it slowly and use low gears on the way down.

itineraries.title: The Albanian Alps in 5 days
itineraries.tagline: Lake Koman, Valbona and the hike over the pass to Theth
itineraries.summary: The classic northern loop: a boat ride through a flooded gorge, two high valleys and one of the best day hikes in the Balkans. Best from June to September, when the pass is clear of snow. No car needed; minibuses and guesthouses handle the logistics.
itineraries.image: Scenery at Theth Village - Northern Albania - 19 (40927652580).jpg
itineraries.transport: Shared minibuses and the Koman ferry; no car needed

days.title: Arrive in Shkodër
days.travel: From Tirana: about 2 hours by bus
days.morning: Travel north from Tirana, or cross from Montenegro.
days.afternoon: Walk the pedestrian old town and visit the Marubi photography museum.
days.evening: Sunset from Rozafa Castle over three rivers and the lake.
days.tip: Ask your guesthouse to book the next morning's Koman ferry transfer and to arrange luggage transport to Theth for day 3.

days.title: The Lake Koman ferry to Valbona
days.travel: About 2 hours by minibus, 2.5–3 hours by boat, then 1 hour to Valbona
days.morning: Early pick-up in Shkodër and the drive to the Koman dam.
days.afternoon: The ferry through the gorge to Fierzë, then a minibus up to Valbona.
days.evening: Dinner at your guesthouse and an early night before the hike.
days.tip: Sit on the open deck for the best views, and bring snacks; there's little food on board.

days.title: Hike Valbona to Theth
days.travel: On foot: about 6–8 hours over the Valbona Pass
days.morning: Set off early and climb through beech forest to the Valbona Pass, at around 1,800 m.
days.afternoon: Descend into the Theth valley, with a stop at the café huts on the way down.
days.evening: Arrive in Theth to a hearty guesthouse dinner. You've earned it.
days.tip: Carry at least 2 litres of water, sun protection and a layer. Snow can linger on the pass into June.

days.title: A day in Theth
days.morning: Walk to the Grunas waterfall and the Lock-in Tower.
days.afternoon: Hike to Theth's Blue Eye pool for a (very cold) swim; allow most of the afternoon for the round trip.
days.evening: Sunset by Theth's church and another home-cooked dinner.
days.tip: There are no ATMs in Theth. Make sure you brought enough cash in lek from Shkodër.

days.title: Back to Shkodër
days.morning: Take the morning minibus down the newly paved road to Shkodër.
days.afternoon: Cycle to Lake Shkodër or the Mesi Bridge, or continue to Tirana.
days.evening: Celebrate with dinner on Kole Idromeno street.
days.tip: Minibuses out of Theth fill up; reserve your seat through your guesthouse the day before.

itineraries.title: Lakes and mountains of the south-east in 4 days
itineraries.tagline: Lake Ohrid, Korçë and the frescoed churches of Voskopojë
itineraries.summary: A quieter side of Albania that most visitors miss: an ancient lake, an elegant highland city and a mountain village full of history. Good in spring, summer and early autumn, and very affordable.
itineraries.bestFor: Second-time visitors, culture and food, slow travel
itineraries.transport: Buses between towns; a taxi for Voskopojë

days.title: Tirana to Lake Ohrid
days.travel: About 3 hours by bus or car
days.morning: Leave Tirana heading east through the mountains.
days.afternoon: Settle into Pogradec and walk the lakeside promenade.
days.evening: Lake fish dinner by the water.
days.tip: Sit on the right-hand side of the bus for lake views as you arrive.

days.title: Drilon springs, then on to Korçë
days.morning: Visit the clear springs and gardens at Drilon, and the lakeside village of Tushemisht.
days.afternoon: Travel to Korçë and wander the restored Old Bazaar.
days.evening: Korça beer and lakror pie in the bazaar.
days.tip: Drilon is about 10 minutes from Pogradec by taxi.

days.title: Voskopojë day trip
days.travel: About 30 minutes each way by car or taxi
days.morning: Head up to Voskopojë and visit its frescoed churches.
days.afternoon: Forest walk and a long lunch at a village guesthouse.
days.evening: Back in Korçë, the National Museum of Medieval Art if you haven't seen it, then dinner.
days.tip: Agree a return time with your taxi driver, or ask your guesthouse to call one for you.

days.title: Back to Tirana
days.travel: About 3.5–4 hours by bus or car
days.morning: Visit the Resurrection Cathedral and have a last coffee on the boulevard.
days.tip: Morning buses are the most reliable; afternoon departures are fewer.
